setup.notInstaller: This file does not contain KyberNow Link ({error}). Download the full installer again.
setup.webview2Ask:
To display their windows, setup and the KyberNow Link app need a Microsoft component, the one Edge uses (WebView2). It is missing on this PC.

Download and install it now? The download is about 2 MB, then Microsoft's installer does the rest.
setup.webview2Failed:
The Microsoft component (WebView2) could not be installed: {error}

Microsoft's page will open: install “Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime”, then run this installer again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall KyberNow Link
uninstall.confirm:
KyberNow Link will be removed from this PC, along with its shortcuts. Pairing links (kybernow://) will no longer open it.

Nothing changes on your computers.

Continue?
uninstall.erase:
Also erase your list of computers, their settings and their passwords?

No: they will still be there if you reinstall KyberNow Link.

windows.title: Windows
windows.old: This Windows is too old (build {build}): KyberNow Link needs Windows 10 22H2 (19045) or later. Install the Windows updates.

arch.title: Processor
arch.arm64: KyberNow Link installs its version built for this processor (ARM64): it runs without emulation and decodes the picture with the chip.
arch.x64: KyberNow Link installs its version built for this processor (x64).

gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.ok: {name}{more}: it decodes the picture, which lowers latency and saves battery.
gpu.basic: Windows basic driver: the processor will decode the picture, more slowly. Install the graphics card driver so the card can do it.

display.title: Display
display.unknown: Unknown size: KyberNow Link will fit the window.
display.ok: {width} × {height} · {hz} Hz: your computer can create a display at exactly this size during the session.

network.title: Local network
network.ok: {ip}: a computer on this network shows up in KyberNow Link on its own.
network.none: No network for now: connect this PC to your network before starting a session.

webview.title: Display engine
webview.ok: It displays the KyberNow Link windows (version {version}, from Microsoft).
webview.missing: Missing on this PC: it will be downloaded from Microsoft and installed (about 2 MB).

existing.label: Installed version
existing.title: KyberNow Link {version} is installed
existing.detail: It will be updated. Your computers, their passwords and your settings are kept.

running.title: KyberNow Link is open
running.detail: It will be closed during installation: a session in progress will be cut off.

errors.appWontClose: KyberNow Link is still open and will not close. Close it, then try again.
errors.placeFiles: could not install the files in {dir}
errors.placeFilesOld: could not install the files; the previous version is still in {dir}
errors.noApp: the app cannot be found in the installer (damaged file?)
errors.noArch: this installer does not contain the {arch} version of KyberNow Link
errors.webview2Start: the WebView2 installer did not start: {error}
